description: A rat the size of a well-fed terrier, with the flat unbothered stare of something that has never once been the smaller animal in the room.
Something small and acquisitive, mostly outline. It has the shape of an animal and the professional manner of a bailiff.
A blind newt the colour of a fingernail, draped over the stone with its chin in the damp. It has been here longer than the grate and intends to outlast it.
